items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: So I told Mr. Martinez, I said, Mr. Martinez, I said, well, the first break you ever. I said, I'd like to get in the WPA band.

ctx.x: Eddie Morris, he was in at Bunnheim too.

Well, Eddie Morris, I didn't know him. I didn't know him. Matter of fact, when I joined a band, they had two bands, two dance bands, which consist of about seven men in each band. And that was all the music they had as far as the WPA band was concerned. And they kept that special to play for the soldiers and the sailors at these USO things. See? Well, when I got in the band, well, I used to play at 1420 Canal Street. Matter of fact, I mean, before I got in the band, well, my brother-in-law used to tell me, he…
I know of him, Joe Martinez.
